title: The Overdeck Cut: remove the state layer, keep every feature, Herdr as default runtime
body:
**PRD:** [drafts/pan-3917.md on overdeck-state](https://github.com/eltmon/overdeck/blob/overdeck-state/drafts/pan-3917.md).
**Decision page:** https://claude.ai/artifact/KJp334EDvqpGFh2cWfUwjT (private artifact, revision 2)
**Backlog triage:** `.tmp/backlog-after-the-cut.md` in the overdeck checkout (918 open issues: 115 close, 122 re-scope, 676 unaffected, 5 unsure)

## Decision

Every feature stays. The state layer goes. Merge train, review convoys, verification gates, UAT, strike, specialists, order books, parked items, backlog sequencer, planning and finalize, container ops and stacks, context injection, costs, God View, Command Deck all survive. What is deleted is the second copy of the truth: the `overdeck-state` branch as a data plane, the per-issue pipeline records and their six status fields, task claims and recovery trips, the SQLite mirror tables, the per-item inspection gate, and the Deacon's sixty reconciliation patrols. Afterward, state is what the tracker and the git repo say, plus what the live sessions say. Herdr v0.9.1 becomes the default session runtime behind a terminal-backend contract; tmux stays supported.

Structural rule that prevents regrowth: **Overdeck stores no status it can derive.**

## Measured scope (non-test source lines, main at 5c9221a)

| Bucket | Lines |
| --- | --- |
| Goes (pure state machinery, file by file in the PRD) | 37,410 |
| Re-pointed (features that stop reading records) | 133,662 |
| Untouched | 187,718 |
| Operator call (8 items) | 6,971 |

Plus: the 57 docs that describe patrols, records, or the state branch; tests of deleted modules; the work-agent stop hook; the two CLAUDE.md philosophy lines; a file-by-file pass over `sync-sources/` hooks and skills.

## What moves where

- PRD drafts, xBRIEF specs, continues, order books, notes, and the backlog sequence migrate from `overdeck-state` back into each project repo under `.pan/` (the legacy path the resolver already falls back to; the repo already tracks `.pan/specs`, `.pan/drafts`, `.pan/continues`, `.pan/backlog/sequence.md`). Open issues only; the archived branch keeps the rest. MYN's plan home is the api repo.
- Item status is a commit trailer plus the checklist in `.pan/continues`. Review verdicts are PR reviews. Gate results are check runs and workspace artifacts. Merge readiness is approvals + green checks + forge mergeability. Liveness is Herdr or tmux. Model per pane is a Herdr metadata token stamped by the launcher.
- The issue's Herdr workspace is the issue tree: every pane in it is a row under the issue card with role, harness, and model, whoever spawned it, including `pan handoff --issue` reviewers that today land in the conversations list.
- Deacon shrinks to deacon-lite: stuck with unpushed work, repeated 429/API errors, session exited with open work, plus the closed-issue reaper. Host-hygiene patrols move to a plain scheduler.
- The flywheel becomes a loop skill in the shape of the gauntlet loop, over the order books and the backlog sequence.
- Day-to-day swarming is the foreman model (same-family workers in-harness, cross-family workers as Herdr panes via `pan spawn`); the swarm plumbing stays in the tree, dormant.

## Operator decisions folded into the PRD (override before dispatch if you disagree)

1. Post-merge deploy loop: keep `pan reload` with one trigger; drop the patrol, intent queue, deploy window, agent restart gate.
2. Restart gate: keep, in-memory request.
3. Auto-merge executor, toggle, policy: keep under merge train, gate on forge mergeability.
4. Closed-issue reaper: keep as deacon-lite.
5. API-error recovery: keep as deacon-lite (detect + one resume).
6. Version ship: keep the verb; ship records become tags and GitHub releases.
7. Deacon controls: keep status, pause, emergency stop; shrink.
8. Migration: open issues only into `.pan/`; MYN plan home = api repo.

## Plan

One day. Prepare (decisions, safety export, Herdr headless, `pre-cut` tag), a wave of nine workers in their own worktrees with hard file scopes (state plane, cloister cut, cloister re-point, backend, frontend, terminal backend contract, CLI, context and docs, tests), integration in dependency order with green gates at every merge and a different-family reviewer over the integrated diff, reload, one PAN issue proving the path end to end, then the flywheel loop's first tick and the backlog triage applied.

Supersedes the machinery list in `WAY-FORWARD.MD`. Re-scopes #3861, #3862, #3863, #3864, #3762, #2350 under the new core.
